results: 1. witnessed description of the event: the right arm reaches and grasps and takes a DYSTONIC posture during the movement, despite a manual muscle testing score of 1 - the movement is ictal, not voluntary
2. head injury history: traumatic brain injury after being thrown from a horse
3. neurological examination between events: right-sided hemiplegia, manual muscle testing grade 1
4. interictal EEG: repetitive sharp waves predominantly in the LEFT FRONTAL area during sleep, with pseudocontinuous 3 Hz slow waves in the same region on awakening
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-traumatic left frontal lobe focal epilepsy, causing ictal right-arm dystonic/complex motor seizures in the setting of right hemiplegia

Alternative: Focal motor seizures arising from the left supplementary motor or premotor cortex due to traumatic brain injury

Alternative: Structural post-traumatic epilepsy from an occult left frontal contusion or scar

Alternative: Psychogenic nonepileptic events (unlikely given the ictal dystonia and concordant left-frontal epileptiform EEG)
dx: Post-traumatic left frontal lobe focal epilepsy, causing ictal right-arm dystonic/complex motor seizures in the setting of right hemiplegia
